goal: Agent memory design review: what the agent stores, where, and how it is read back.
use: Agent memory design review: what the agent stores, where, and how it is read back. Use when an agent keeps notes or facts between sessions.

steps.note: List the memory. Each kind of thing stored, its source and its purpose.
Check the store. Confirm where it lives and what format it uses.
Check the reads. Note how memory enters a new session and how much of it.
Check the growth. Flag memory that only grows and never shrinks.
Report. The memory kinds, their store, the read path and the growth problem.
